subject.title: fix(workspaces): reject raw file binding pointers

question: Should released Markdown and CSV bindings that currently ignore non-root pointers become fail-closed binding errors?
rationale: The implementation correctly prevents an unsatisfied pointer from returning broader data, but merging deliberately changes successful released behavior into an error for existing workspace documents.

options.title: Accept fail-closed behavior
options.body: Merge the canonical-helper implementation and clarify the raw-file pointer and upgrade behavior in Workspaces documentation.

options.title: Preserve released behavior
options.body: Keep returning raw content for existing Markdown and CSV pointers until maintainers define a different backward-compatible transition.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the canonical-helper implementation and clarify the raw-file pointer and upgrade behavior in Workspaces documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a bundled-plugin compatibility policy decision rather than an unresolved mechanical code defect.
